digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery workflow modules
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py exceed or hit the 800 LOC module-size CI cap, blocking further edits without refactoring

completion.py contains four distinct concerns (operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-close bug-screen, verdict reconciliation) that should be separated into dedicated modules with clear contractual boundaries
completion_recovery.py contains three distinct concerns (criteria surface/bounds, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration) that should be extracted into dedicated modules
The refactoring must preserve all existing public API contracts, re-exports, and monkeypatch/test-import paths so callers remain unchanged
All moved symbols must remain locatable and patchable at their original dotted-name paths via re-export facades, and test import/monkeypatch targets must be updated to follow the moves
